channel.title: CODE38 (English)
channel.description: Geopolitics, defense, Ukraine’s economy and finance — without rose-tinted glasses.

item.title: A country of sellers without a till: why Ukraine has been cut off from PayPal and Stripe for 15 years
item.description: Ukrainians sell more on Etsy than Spain, yet can’t accept PayPal payments. Moldova can. A retrospective since 2011: the regulator, the companies, the geography of sanctions.

item.title: Geopolitics without rose-tinted glasses: why weapons aren’t a reward for “good behavior”
item.description: Sixty years of covert US arms deliveries: dictators, Islamists, drug traffickers — and not one certificate of clean governance.

item.title: An economy of cashiers or a nation of creators?
item.description: The bitter truth about global brands: why multinational expansion and real investment in local business are two different things.

item.title: The economic limits of total mobilization
item.description: Why the slogan “everyone will fight” doesn’t survive contact with the budget — and what to do about Russia’s autumn mobilization.

item.title: Why “expiring money” would be economic suicide
item.description: A popular conspiracy theory about CBDCs from the standpoint of basic economics — simply, with examples, without panic.

item.title: The pension trap: why people in their 30s and 40s should rely only on their own investments
item.description: Demographic collapse, the bankruptcy of the pay-as-you-go system and a practical strategy for personal savings.

item.title: Ballistic missile defense: technology, strategy and the task for Ukraine
item.description: Patriot vs SAMP/T, intercept layers, early warning, Link-16 and the Freyja project — what actually shoots down ballistic missiles.

item.title: An alternative macrohistory of biocentrism
item.description: What if humanity had renounced the exploitation of animals in the 14th century: two scenarios — an optimistic one and a critical one.

item.title: A dollar at 8, roads instead of missiles, and why we are still paying
item.description: The economic decisions of every Ukrainian president in numbers — from Kravchuk’s hyperinflation to the “dollar at 8” and roads instead of missiles.
